name: ED: Exosomes & Shockwave
title: Erectile Dysfunction Treatment in Tustin | Shockwave & Exosomes | OC Concierge Doctor
description: Erectile dysfunction treatment in Tustin with Tariq A. Khan, MD, combining low-intensity shockwave therapy and exosomes to target blood flow.
h1: Address the blood flow behind ED.
lede: Erection strength often fades gradually with age, sometimes without men noticing. Dr. Khan combines shockwave therapy with exosomes to target the blood-flow problems behind erectile dysfunction.
glance: A combined approach aimed at the cause, with a full medical workup first.

signs.heading: Signs to talk about
signs.intro: ED can be an early sign of heart or hormone problems, so it is worth a full evaluation.

basics.heading: Why blood flow matters
paras: Most erectile dysfunction comes down to blood flow. Low-intensity shockwave therapy uses sound waves to stimulate the tissue, and exosomes are added for their potential role in supporting repair.
Because ED can signal heart disease, diabetes, or low testosterone, Dr. Khan starts with a medical evaluation and labs, so you treat the cause and not only the symptom.

steps.heading: How it works
items: History, exam, and labs, including testosterone.
Dr. Khan tracks your response and adjusts the plan.

faq: No exosome product is FDA-approved for erectile dysfunction, and shockwave for ED is still being studied. Dr. Khan reviews all options, including proven medications, with you.
Could low testosterone be the cause?
It can contribute. Dr. Khan checks your levels as part of the evaluation. See low testosterone.

next.heading: Start with what's actually causing the problem.
next.para: A private evaluation looks at blood flow, hormones, medications, and overall health before Dr. Khan recommends a treatment approach.
